The full roadmap section 13.8 eleven-step 'Персонаж и развитие' scenario runs end-to-end, in literal order, over already-merged ODY-S04-101..113 public APIs and real SQLite: local Draft creation; campaign-template selection at bind time with an independence-from-later-template-edit check; host Ruleset-compatibility validation (negative and positive) and submit; MainGM approval transitioning both ApprovalState and LifecycleStatus; MainGM-only development-point grant; an immediate owner attribute purchase with duplicate-CommandId no-double-spend; critical-success evidence recording; a skill 5+ recommendation reserve-then-resolve cycle that consumes its evidence and rejects reuse by a second recommendation; a reconnect (brand-new repository instance against the same campaign.db) reconstructing both GetCharacterHistory's own tracked event sequence and GetCharacter's full authoritative state; and a .odchar export/import round trip landing as a fresh-CharacterId Draft preserving the round-tripped mechanics state. No new production code exists to support this test.
